{{Uitech}}
This page details how AddOns load and unload, including the order when information becomes available such as SavedVariables and character details.

==AddOn loading order==
{{main|TOC format}}
Blizzard's AddOns usually load first (the native UI), followed by custom AddOns in alphabetical order.  However, [[.toc]] directives can override this behaviour (e.g. <code>LoadOnDemand</code> or <code>LoadWith</code>).

Within an AddOn:
* [[XML]] and [[Lua]] files load sequentially as listed in the [[.toc]] file, and also when reaching {{api|t=x|Include}} or {{api|t=x|Script}} tags in XML.
* By default, [[Saving variables between game sessions|Saved variables]] load after the last file listed in the TOC. This can be reconfigured by the [[TOC format#LoadSavedVariablesFirst|LoadSavedVariablesFirst]] directive to instead be loaded before all files in an addon.
* Finally, {{api|t=e|ADDON_LOADED}} fires to indicate the AddOn has finished loading.  This is the earliest time for an AddOn to read its saved variables.

==Events during login==
AddOns load in parallel to the login screen, but can register for events to access information as it becomes available.  However, LoadOnDemand AddOns might trigger part-way or after all steps have finished:


<strong class="apialt">Normal sequence:</strong>
# {{api|t=e|ADDON_LOADED: addOnName}}
#* Fires when each AddOn finishes loading, including all files and saved variables.
#* Confirm which AddOn loaded using the first argument (in case a LoadOnDemand AddOn loaded in parallel), access saved variables, and deregister from ADDON_LOADED to avoid repeated callbacks.
# {{api|t=e|PLAYER_LOGIN}}
#* Fires during the loading screen when logging in or reloading, before the first {{api|t=e|PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD}}. Most information about the game world is available to the UI.
#* Finish any one-time initialization and frame placement, so they are in place when the load screen disappears.
# {{api|t=e|PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD: isInitialLogin, isReloadingUi}}
#* Fires during any loading screen including logging in, reloading or entering an instance.  The first time happens after {{api|t=e|PLAYER_LOGIN}}.  If this is a reload, talent information is also available.
#* Finish any reoccuring (ie, instance-dependent) initialization and frame placement, so they are in place when the load screen disappears.
# {{api|t=e|PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED}}
#* Fires when the player is entering combat lockdown.  If the player is in combat while reloading, it will follow {{api|t=e|PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD}}.
#* Finish any outstanding modifications to secure frames, as they are unalterable during combat lockdown.
# {{api|t=e|SPELLS_CHANGED}}
#* Fires when spells in the spellbook is populated, and again when it changes.  Currently, this event fires after the preceeding events (but it was not always this way).
#* Update any pertinent non-secure frames.


;<span class="apialt">Error condition:</span>
: {{api|t=e|SAVED_VARIABLES_TOO_LARGE: addOnName}}
:* Fires when the client runs out of memory while attempting to load saved variables, after {{api|t=e|ADDON_LOADED}}.<ref name="SAVED_VARIABLES_TOO_LARGE">{{ref web|title=Patch 5.4 Addon Changes - Saved Variables|url=http://us.battle.net/wow/en/forum/topic/9362996672|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20131208192601/http://us.battle.net/wow/en/forum/topic/9362996672|date=20130624|author={{Blizz}}[[Crithto]]}}</ref>
:* Usually there is no further action; the client displays a [https://www.townlong-yak.com/framexml/live/go/StaticPopupDialogs.SAVED_VARIABLES_TOO_LARGE popup] informing the user of the error.

==Events during logout==
#{{api|t=e|PLAYER_LEAVING_WORLD}}
#* Does not imply logout, as it may preceed another loading screen (instances, continents, etc.).
#{{api|t=e|PLAYER_LOGOUT}}
#* Last chance to modify SavedVariables before AddOns unload.{{fact}}
#{{api|t=e|ADDONS_UNLOADING}}
#* All AddOns commit SavedVariables prior to reloading, quitting or logging off.  Called once only, rather than for each AddOn.  This does not occur during a crash or Alt-F4.{{fact}}

==Example==
<span style="font-size: 1.6em">LoadingOrder.toc</span>
 ##Interface: {{API LatestInterface}}
 ##Title: Loading Order Demo
 ##SavedVariables: LoadingOrderSavedVar
 file1.lua
 file2.xml
 file3.lua
<span style="font-size: 1.6em">file1.lua</span>
<syntaxhighlight lang="lua">
print("This loads first")
</syntaxhighlight>
<span style="font-size: 1.6em">file2.xml</span>
<syntaxhighlight lang="xml">
 <Ui>
  <Frame name="TemplateFrame" virtual="true">
    <Frames><Frame><Scripts><OnLoad>print("Inherited elements of the frame are processed first.") </OnLoad></Scripts></Frame></Frames>
  </Frame>
  <Frame inherits="TemplateFrame">
   <Frames>
    <Frame>
     <Scripts><OnLoad>print("First child frame's OnLoad fires first")</OnLoad></Scripts>
    </Frame>
    <Frame>
     <Scripts><OnLoad>print("Second child frame's OnLoad fires second")</OnLoad></Scripts>
    </Frame>
    <Scripts><OnLoad>print("Parent frame's OnLoad fires after its children's.")</OnLoad></Scripts>
   </Frames>
  </Frame>
  <Script file="file2.5.lua"/>
</Ui>
</syntaxhighlight>
<span style="font-size: 1.6em">file2.5.lua</span>
<syntaxhighlight lang="lua">
print("Files included in XML are executed as they are encountered")
</syntaxhighlight>
<span style="font-size: 1.6em">file3.lua</span>
<syntaxhighlight lang="lua">
LoadingOrderSavedVar = 0  -- default value until ADDON_LOADED
print("The last file has loaded.")

local frame = CreateFrame("Frame")
frame:RegisterFrame("ADDON_LOADED")
frame:SetScript("OnEvent", function(self, event)
  if event == "ADDON_LOADED" and arg1="LoadingOrder" then
    LoadingOrderSavedVar = LoadingOrderSavedVar + 1
    if LoadingOrderSavedVar then
      print("The demo has now loaded .." LoadingOrderSavedVar .. " times".)
    end
  end
end)
</syntaxhighlight>

==Patch changes==
* {{Patch 11.1.5|note=Added the <code>LoadSavedVariablesFirst</code> [[.toc]] directive.}}
* {{Patch 5.4.0|note={{api|t=e|SAVED_VARIABLES_TOO_LARGE}} added.<ref name="SAVED_VARIABLES_TOO_LARGE" />}}
* {{Patch 5.4.0|note=Circa 5.4.0, {{api|t=e|PLAYER_ALIVE}} stopped firing during login. It now only fires when a player is resurrected (before releasing spirit) or when a player releases spirit.|comment=Previously, AddOns could use {{api|t=e|PLAYER_ALIVE}} to signal that quest and talent information were available because it was the last event to fire, even later than {{api|t=e|PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD}}.}}
* {{Patch 3.0.2|note={{api|t=e|VARIABLES_LOADED}} is no longer a reliable part of the addon loading process.  It fires in response to CVars, Keybindings and other associated "Blizzard" variables being loaded, and therefore may happen after {{api|t=e|PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD}}.|comment=The event remains useful to override positioning data stored in layout-cache.txt.}}
